image_reference_use.purpose: Original visual evidence for generated storyboard art direction; diagram-region crops exclude presenter/caption distractions.
image_reference_use.keep: Visual hierarchy, shape/texture, icon mass, typography, color roles, whitespace and persistent-object relationships when appropriate.
image_reference_use.replace: Source product labels, business claims, values and entities according to the new verified script.
image_reference_use.never_use: Rejected reconstruction screenshots as style references.

confidence.source_images: Directly extracted from original uploaded footage; not generated or taken from the failed recreation.
confidence.coverage: All 58 curated instances plus the previous 206 estimated visual anchors are indexed; micro-transition exhaustiveness is not certified.
confidence.pedagogy_and_templates: Editorial interpretations grounded in the paired transcript and images.
confidence.timing: Estimated teaching/cut anchors, not word alignment.

source_specific_observation.status: Sequence-level source observations are attached in prior_source_observations. The family motion grammar is a proposed reusable pattern, not a frame-exact claim about this instance.

reading_vs_reveal_rule: Reading direction and actual reveal order are separate. Prefer the source-specific observation when reconstructing; align adaptation order to what the new narration introduces.
